note: Provision-level applicability records for the reference entity profiles. Applicability here is a lab self-assessment, not legal advice. A mapping to a control never implies legal compliance.

obligations.rationale: Applies to essential/important entities; member state, registration and size criteria are not fixed for the reference profile.
obligations.requirement_summary: Management bodies approve and oversee cybersecurity risk-management measures and can be held accountable; members receive training.

obligations.rationale: Same profile conditions as Article 20. Used as a control-design reference in the laboratory regardless of legal applicability.
obligations.requirement_summary: All-hazards measures including incident handling, business continuity, supply-chain security and effectiveness assessment.

obligations.rationale: Reporting duties attach to designated entities. The laboratory plans a tabletop notification assessment only; no real notification is made or claimed.
obligations.requirement_summary: Early warning within 24h, incident notification within 72h and a final report within one month for significant incidents.

obligations.provision: Regulation 10 - Security duties of operators of essential services
obligations.rationale: Applies only if the reference entity meets OES thresholds for the energy subsector; the profile assumes this for analysis without evaluating real thresholds.
obligations.requirement_summary: Appropriate and proportionate measures to manage risks to network and information systems supporting the essential service.

obligations.provision: Objective B, Principle B5 - Resilient Networks and Systems
obligations.rationale: Framework expectation, not law. Directly exercised by the backend-loss experiment: local control continuity under connectivity failure.
obligations.requirement_summary: Resilience against incidents is built into the design, operation and management of systems supporting the essential function.

obligations.provision: Objective C, Principle C1 - Security Monitoring
obligations.rationale: Partially exercised: interruption and restoration observability (SC-04/SC-05) relates here. Full monitoring coverage was not tested.
obligations.requirement_summary: Monitoring to detect potential security problems and track the effectiveness of protective measures.

obligations.provision: Objective D, Principle D1 - Response and Recovery Planning
obligations.rationale: The open area of the project. SC-06 INCONCLUSIVE maps here as a documented gap, not a pass.
obligations.requirement_summary: Well-defined and tested incident response and recovery capabilities for the essential function.
